quotes.text:
Picture a mic, the stage is empty
A beat like this might tempt me
To pose, show my rings and my fat gold chain
Grab the mic like I'm on Soul Train
quotes.reference: 1987, Eric B. & Rakim, I Know You Got Soul:

examples: If we add the drum kit, we'll have to mic the orchestra.

quotes.text: At 11:00 am, Doug mics up with me on the radio, and I advise him to go back to camp to get a quad, that we have a monster down.
